preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(name, str) for name in bird_names)
preconditions.description: All elements in bird_names must be strings.
Each bird name must consist of at most four words.

postconditions.description: The output array must have the same length as the input array.

postconditions.expression: all(len(code) == 4 and code.isupper() for code in return_value)
postconditions.description: Each code in the output array must be a four-letter uppercase string.

postconditions.expression: all(code == ''.join(word[:2] if i < 2 else word[:1] for i, word in enumerate(name.replace('-', ' ').split())) for name, code in zip(bird_names, return_value))
postconditions.description: Each code must be generated according to the specified rules based on the number of words in the bird name.
